'''Pg'lax''' was an entrepreneurial [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] who established the [[Quick Pit docking bay service]] on the outskirts of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

==History==
Pg'lax himself was born in the [[Roche system]], and was noted for his love of racing. He became one of the most successful crew crew leaders on the professional [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] circuit, and was on Tatooine when his success caught up with him and a group of rival crews waylaid Pg'lax and his team, sabotaging their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and stranding them on Tatooine. A brief career as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] was followed by another attempt to destroy his career, and Pg'lax fled to Mos Eisley. There, where he discovered his niche as a starship servicer, and he eventually was able to earn enough credits to start the Quick Pit operation.
